name: one leg l-sit
description: An L-sit with one leg straight and the other tucked. It is a step between the tuck L-sit and the full hold.
instructions: Get into a tuck L-sit with your arms locked.
Straighten one leg out in front of you at hip height.
Keep the other knee pulled in close to your chest.
Point the toes of the straight leg and keep the knee locked.
Hold, then switch which leg is straight on the next set.
